_comment: Compatibility matrix for the extensions that run on the login screen (session mode gdm) or the lock screen (unlock-dialog).
validated: GNOME Shell majors where the extension was actually tested: 'bench' = tests/greeter/bench.sh passed,
'real' = used on a real machine. Fenestra Update turns off every login/lock extension that is not validated for
the target GNOME before it restarts into the new release, so the standard GNOME login always remains.
To validate a new GNOME: run tests/greeter/bench.sh in a fedora:N image, then add N here with the evidence.
